summary: Moderate: libxml2 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The libxml2 library is a development toolbox providing the implementation of various XML standards.

Security Fix(es):

* libxml2: mingw-libxml2: libxml2: Denial of Service via crafted XML input due to use-after-free (CVE-2026-6653)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* libxml2: CVE-2025-9714 fix (Rocky Linux-119279) backported wrong upstream commit ? dyn:map recursion still crashes (JIRA:Rocky Linux-249282)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
